title: Is autism hereditary?
metaTitle: Autism and Genetics - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the role of genetics in autism and how we at Pinnacle Blooms Network use a comprehensive therapeutic approach to help every child reach their full potential.
html: Autism is a complex condition with a variety of causes, and indeed, genetics do play a significant role. However, it's important to understand that while certain genes may make a person more susceptible to developing autism, it's generally a combination of both genetic and environmental factors that influence its onset. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we stay attuned to the latest research in this field, and our all-encompassing therapeutic approach focuses on improving the individual skills and abilities of each child, helping them to thrive.
